Posted April 16, 2001
(MarijuanaNews note: I am posting this story for three reasons.

1. It is truly outrageous and needs to be as widely reported as possible. The prohibitionist press is usually too busy reporting the latest reefer madness about what marijuana supposedly does to report on what marijuana prohibition actually does.
See
In South Dakota Police Use Intimidation To Get People To Give Up Their Rights. How Marijuana Prohibition Really Works.

2. It demonstrates the immorality of the techniques used by the narks, for whom the end always justifies the means. We must never cede the moral high ground to these murderous thugs.

3. It shows that the " Drug War " is really a war on marijuana users. The targets here were small-scale marijuana users.

The Seattle Post-Intelligencer has generally been above average in its reporting on marijuana prohibition,
